## Summary

[Partial] Use a trip meter and the fill-to-fill method to calculate accurate fuel economy while accounting for tire size. [t2277]

## Tools

- [Partial] Odometer or trip meter [t2277]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use the 'fill-to-fill' method (divide gallons added by miles driven) rather than full-to-empty for accuracy. [t2277]
- Average results over 2-3 fill-ups to account for tank variations and driving conditions. [t2277]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Not accounting for tire size differences when using the factory odometer. [t2277]
- [Partial] Letting fuel get too low before refilling, causing inconsistent readings. [t2277]
- [Partial] Confusing 'full-to-empty' calculations with actual capacity usage without adjusting for residual gas. [t2277]
